question: What if I pick up a 5 hour shift on Nov 7?
text:
ANSWER: The extra shift adds $71.69 to your Wed, Nov 18 paycheck [C15].
WHY:
- A shift worked by Sat, Oct 31 is paid Tue, Nov 3, before you run out [C16].
- Your money runs out on Mon, Nov 9 [C7].
DO THIS:
1. Work a shift by Sat, Oct 31 to get paid Tue, Nov 3 [C16].
2. Track spending to avoid running out Mon, Nov 9 [C7].
NOTE: Shift pay arrives Wed, Nov 18 [C15].
